description: Community Nonprofits Leverage their Collective Experience to Create a Green Jobs Workforce is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Green Workforce Collaborative. A group of community-based human resources and environmental nonprofit organizations leverage their experience in working with employers, city governments, and underemployed communities to address gaps in the resilience workforce pipeline. Coverage: Central Texas (2024). The toolkit gives Central Texas as the location, 2024 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
